title: Kitten dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#F6A04D'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='71' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#FFE0B0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='17' fill='#F6A04D'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='36,26 33,10 46,21' fill='#F6A04D'/>
  <polygon points='64,26 67,10 54,21' fill='#F6A04D'/>
  <polygon points='38,24 36,15 44,22' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <polygon points='62,24 64,15 56,22' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='37' r='3.5' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='37' r='3.5' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='1.3' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='1.3' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='50,43 47,46 53,46' fill='#FF8FA3'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 46 Q47 50 44 48 M50 46 Q53 50 56 48' stroke='#D2691E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='44' r='3' fill='#FFB6C1' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='3' fill='#FFB6C1' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='42' x2='20' y2='40' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='46' x2='20' y2='47' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='42' x2='80' y2='40' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='46' x2='80' y2='47' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm up -->
  <path d='M33 60 Q20 45 18 32' stroke='#F6A04D' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='30' r='4' fill='#FFE0B0'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M67 60 Q80 58 88 50' stroke='#F6A04D' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='49' r='4' fill='#FFE0B0'/>
  <!-- left leg kicked -->
  <path d='M40 82 Q28 88 20 84' stroke='#F6A04D' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='83' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FFE0B0'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <path d='M60 82 Q68 92 76 90' stroke='#F6A04D' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='89' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FFE0B0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M68 72 Q84 74 86 62 Q87 56 82 54' stroke='#F6A04D' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M42 24 Q50 20 58 24' stroke='#D2691E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 32 Q34 38 36 44' stroke='#D2691E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 32 Q66 38 64 44' stroke='#D2691E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#7FE3FF'/>
  <line x1='26' y1='40' x2='26' y2='30' stroke='#7FE3FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='34' r='2.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <line x1='80' y1='34' x2='80' y2='24' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='66' r='2' fill='#7FE3FF'/>
  <line x1='88' y1='66' x2='88' y2='58' stroke='#7FE3FF' stroke-width='1.2'/>
</svg>
